title: Nonnegativity of a matching Fourier factor
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let a perfect matching be given in the complete multipartite graph with $q$ parts of $k$ vertices each, fix a part, and assign labels in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to the matching edges. The Fourier factor for that part is nonnegative.
